purpose: adversarial 10건 평가 정본(superseding fixture authority). corpus/gold 원본 무수정 — 평가에서만 corpus contractGold adversarial 부분집합을 대체.
method: 현 구현 세션과 분리된 독립 blind 검수자 A/B(중립 ID, 기존 gold/모델예측/점수/실패항목 비노출, 파일 접근 금지) 병렬 판정 → A/B 완전 합의 10/10, adjudication 불요. scopeClass는 동결 resolveScopeClass 공식으로 arrays에서 기계 파생. ambiguous 합의 항목은 게이트 분모 제외(억지 정답 금지).
rulesGivenToReviewers: 동결 계약(taxonomy 14·contentType=format·admission core/secondary/reject·2범주는 분리불가 교차도메인만·grounding exact-substring·declaredSection은 힌트) + 사건위치/판매시장/관련국 3구분(David 지시) + quotable 단서 열거(지명·기관·리테일러·통화·법률) + sourceCountry/언어는 위치 증거 아님

reviewerA.rationale: A user's home-cooking recipe post; core topic is everyday cooking, so life only. declaredSection 'politics' has zero support in the text and is discarded; '사천' names an ingredient style, not an event location, so no jurisdiction is groundable.

reviewerB.rationale: User post sharing a home cooking recipe; life is the single core topic and declaredSection politics has zero textual merit. '사천' names a cooking style/ingredient, not the location of the described home activity, so no event jurisdiction can be grounded.

reviewerA.rationale: A first-party announcement article about a developer-platform program for open source maintainers — core tech; declaredSection 'fashion' is plainly wrong. The program is an inherently online, non-territorial event and sourceCountry US is not evidence, so eventJurisdictions stays empty.

reviewerB.rationale: Announcement reporting a new open-source contributor program → tech core; declaredSection fashion is plainly wrong. The program is an online/global platform initiative with no groundable national event location, and sourceCountry US is never evidence, so jurisdictions stay empty.

reviewerA.rationale: A user asking for advice on a PC build — community format, core topic PC hardware (tech); gaming is only the intended use, so secondary. The KRW budget '150만원' grounds the described purchasing activity in KR; not a deal, so salesMarket is empty.

reviewerB.rationale: User post asking for PC-build advice → community, tech core; gaming is only the PC's intended use, a secondary theme. The KRW budget '150만원' is a currency amount grounding the described activity in KR; a personal build materially affects no country, so relevance is empty.

reviewerA.rationale: A purchase offer (price, discount link, shipping) for an SSD — deal format, core topic computer hardware (tech), not 'life' as filed. Korean retailer '쿠팡', the KRW price '89000원', and shipping terms ground the offer's market as KR.

reviewerB.rationale: Purchase offer for an SSD → deal format; the topic is computer hardware, so tech is the core category (declaredSection life gets no independent merit). Retailer '쿠팡' and the KRW price '89000원' ground the redeemable market as KR.

reviewerA.rationale: Despite the sports-section filing, the event is a holding company's disclosed 3-trillion-won capex investment — core business; the club is a mere ownership mention, so sports is rejected, and the semiconductor sector is context (tech secondary). The KRW amount '3조원' grounds the event in KR.

reviewerB.rationale: A corporate disclosure of a 3-trillion-won semiconductor investment is core business news; '구단 모기업' merely identifies the company, so sports (the declaredSection) is a mere mention and rejected, with the semiconductor angle a secondary tech theme. The KRW amount '3조원' grounds the event and its material relevance in KR.

reviewerA.rationale: A national law expanding tax credits for chip firms passed by the legislature is a genuinely inseparable business-and-politics event, so both are accepted; the semiconductor industry itself is secondary tech. The National Assembly '국회' and the national law '반도체 특별법' ground the event in KR.

reviewerB.rationale: A special law passed by the National Assembly expanding corporate tax credits is the contract's paradigm inseparable cross-domain event — jointly politics (legislation, 여야 합의) and business (corporate tax support) — with the semiconductor industry a secondary tech theme. Institution name '국회' and national law '반도체 특별법' ground KR.

reviewerB.rationale: The core event is the earnings beat (business); the partisan sparring is a reaction — a second-order effect — so politics is a real but secondary theme, not a jointly-core field like a law. No character-for-character span grounds any jurisdiction.

'美 연준' and '미국 연방준비제도' ground the event in the US; no other country is textually grounded, so relevance beyond the US (e.g. KR) cannot be asserted despite the Korean outlet.
